title: tocoyena gracilis
intro: Tocoyena gracilis, commonly known as Yellow Trumpetbush, is a plant species native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of anxiety, insomnia, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Tocoyena gracilis include sedative, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a promising natural remedy for various health conditions. Bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids have been identified in Tocoyena gracilis, contributing to its medicinal properties and therapeutic potential.
